subject: English Home Language

show.line: Moon, spoon, boot. Hear the oo in the middle? Tree, bee, feet. Hear the ee? Two letters, one sound!

rounds.prompt: Which picture has the oo sound, like moon?
Which picture has the ee sound, like tree?
Read this word. It has oo in the middle.
Read this word. It has ee in the middle.

rounds.praise: Yes! Moon, with oo in the middle.

rounds.prompt: Oo like moon, or ee like tree? Put each picture in its group.

hints: Stretch the middle of the word. Moooon. Treeee.
Two letters the same, side by side, make one long sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word with oo like moon.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Tree has ee. Spoon has oo like moon.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Moon, spoon. Oo in the middle!

parent_line: Can hear and read the oo and ee sounds in the middle of words.
